title: Study on preparation and performance of cement-stabilized macadam containing ground sludge gasification slag (GSGS)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7139-7148
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00462D, Paper

Xiaoyan Zhang, Xiaoqi Wang, Zhiyong Li, Kele Wang, Juntao Ma, Shunbo Zhao
This study discusses composite cementitious material performance. Explore the influence of varying ratio of sludge gasification slag replacement on the effectiveness of material properties. Unveiled micro–macro correlations, setting theoretical foundation for cement-stabilized macadam studies.
